note: The extractor's failure envelope when LinkedIn throttles the page. A1 §2.9 cites the Unipile provider-limit baselines as the reference ceilings; a 429 is transient and must map to retryable_rate_limit, which is the kind the poller backs off on. No `messages` key — the payload is not a message batch.

error.message: HTTP 429: too many requests — you have reached the weekly invitation limit.
